image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a cluster of ripe, dark purple figs on a white background. The figs exhibit a glossy, wrinkled skin texture with deep red and purple hues. One central fig is oriented to show its stem end and the characteristic ostiole (eye) at the bottom. The lighting creates strong specular highlights, emphasizing the smooth yet irregular surface of the fruit.
